title: Educational ED World Model Transition Pair Schema
description: Minimal source-faithful schema for educational emergency medicine transition pairs. Pairs capture treatment-response transitions or explicit time-progression transitions. The dataset stores only information stated in the source scenario; engine defaults, dose imputation, duration/onset assumptions, PK/PD curves, and hidden physiology states are not stored here. Mixed triggers or prompt-only events should be omitted from this file. For medication actions, params include drug_name, dose, unit, route, or dose_range only when a specific medication and parameter are explicitly stated. If the source provides medication options or drug-class options, do not encode those options in params; preserve the original wording in raw_text and use kind_hint as the engine-facing action class. Pair-level before.features uses only the fixed compact feature set: rhythm, oxygen_device, FiO2, intubated, vent, PEEP_cmH2O, neuro_status, glucose_mmol_l. Project-level oxygen device default FiO2 values apply when a device is stated but FiO2 is not explicit; if no oxygen device/support is stated, set oxygen_device to null and FiO2 to 0.21. neuro_status is a string field that can store GCS, AVPU, or qualitative mental status. All oxygen-support actions, including oxygen application, NRB, BVM, BiPAP, BVM with PEEP valve, and PEEP-setting language, use kind_hint='oxygen_support' with fixed params: oxygen_device, FiO2, PEEP_used, PEEP_cmH2O. Do not use a separate ventilation_adjustment kind_hint in this dataset version. Intubation-related airway_management actions may use a fixed compact params convention: procedure='intubation', stage='attempt' or 'completed' or null, rsi_medication_used=true/false/null, bvm_before=true/false/null, and intubated=true/false/null. Use null when the source does not state the item; false only when the source explicitly states absence or when a source action clearly lacks PEEP by contrast with a separate PEEP action. Standalone BVM/NRB/oxygen actions remain oxygen_support actions.

scenario_description.description: Brief case-level description. May be provided to LLM-based engines; should not include target values from individual transition pairs.

test_code.description: Stable test-bank code, e.g., BMP, VBG, TROP, CXR, ECG, ECHO.

test_category.description: Broad test category, e.g., lab, blood_gas, cardiac_test, endocrine_test, hematology, imaging, ecg, ultrasound, echo.

supporting_findings.description: Source-faithful supporting documents represented as a flat test-bank-oriented list. Each item uses a stable test_code, test_name, test_category, and compact result_summary.

case_context.description: Case-level information strictly grounded in scenario text. history should reflect the Patient Profile/PMH rather than inferred diagnosis labels.

history.description: Strictly use stated past medical history from the scenario.

vitals.description: Sparse or complete vital signs. Missing/unstated values can be null or omitted.

features.description: Case-level non-vital features. For pair.input.before.features, use before_features instead. Use neuro_status as a string field for GCS, AVPU, or qualitative mental status.

raw_text.description: Source-faithful action text without the target values after the arrow.

kind_hint.description: Coarse action class used by lightweight engines and runtime world model. Examples: fluid_bolus, fluid_infusion, vasopressor, vasodilator, rate_control, negative_chronotrope, diuretic, oxygen_support, noninvasive_ventilation, airway_management, synchronized_cardioversion, defibrillation, time_passage, no_action, analgesia, unknown. Additional project action classes may be used when explicitly adopted by the dataset. In this dataset version, oxygen application/NRB/BVM/BiPAP/BVM with PEEP/PEEP-setting actions should be encoded as oxygen_support using fixed oxygen_support params; do not use ventilation_adjustment. For intubation workflow, prefer airway_management with fixed intubation params.

params.description: Sparse action parameters explicitly stated in the source. For oxygen_support actions, use the fixed compact convention: oxygen_device, FiO2, PEEP_used, PEEP_cmH2O. Use null when device/FiO2/PEEP value is not stated; use PEEP_used=true when the source explicitly states PEEP/PEEP valve/BiPAP; use PEEP_used=false when the action clearly states a non-PEEP oxygen device/action such as NRB or BVM without PEEP. For airway_management/intubation actions, use the fixed compact convention where applicable: procedure='intubation'; stage is 'attempt', 'completed', or null; rsi_medication_used is true/false/null; bvm_before is true/false/null; intubated is true/false/null. Standalone BVM remains oxygen_support with oxygen_device='BVM' and FiO2=1.0. Other examples: amount_ml, fluid_type, drug_name, dose, unit, route, dose_range, energy_j, elapsed_min. Do not impute missing dose, route, onset, duration, or hidden state.

procedure.description: For intubation workflow, use 'intubation'. Other source-faithful procedure labels may be used for non-intubation airway procedures.

stage.description: For intubation workflow: attempt = attempted intubation; completed = successful intubation; null = not stated or medication-only trigger.

rsi_medication_used.description: Whether RSI/intubation medication is explicitly used. true when source states RSI meds/with paralytic/induction; false only when source explicitly says without paralytic/no RSI medication; null when not stated.

bvm_before.description: Whether BVM was used before intubation. true/false only when explicitly stated; null when not stated.

intubated.description: Whether the action explicitly results in an intubated state. true for successful/completed intubation; false for failed/attempt-only branches when explicit; null when not stated.

PEEP_used.description: For oxygen_support actions, whether PEEP/PEEP valve/BiPAP is explicitly part of the action. Use true when stated, false when the action clearly lacks PEEP, and null when not stated/ambiguous.

vitals.description: Sparse target vitals explicitly stated in the source.

features.description: Sparse target non-vital features explicitly stated in the source, such as rhythm or GCS.

target_vitals.description: Only these vitals are evaluated for direction and masked normalized L2.

target_features.description: Non-vital features to evaluate categorically or with feature-specific logic.

pair_type.description: physiology_response = explicit treatment/action modifier with target response. time_progression = explicit time passage/no-action deterioration pair. Mixed triggers should be omitted from main pairs.

modifier_text.description: Original source text for audit. It may include target values and must not be passed to engines.

before_features.description: Fixed compact observable support/rhythm/neuro/metabolic feature set used in pair.input.before.features. Do not add extra keys. If rhythm, intubated, vent, PEEP_cmH2O, neuro_status, or glucose_mmol_l is not stated or not applicable, use null. For oxygen fields: if an oxygen device is stated, set FiO2 using the project's device default unless the source explicitly gives FiO2 or oxygen percentage. If no oxygen device/support is stated, set oxygen_device to null and FiO2 to 0.21. neuro_status should be stored as a string, e.g., 'GCS 15', 'AVPU: Pain', 'drowsy', 'unresponsive', or null. glucose_mmol_l should be numeric when explicitly stated, otherwise null.

target_features.description: Sparse non-vital target features explicitly stated in the source. Use only when a non-vital feature changes and is an evaluation target. neuro_status should be stored as a string when present.

oxygen_device_defaults.description: Project-level default FiO2 values for oxygen devices when source gives device but not FiO2.
